Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.

Se il file manca ritorna stringa vuota, come fa già `ResponsiveImage`. Va usato nella section `lcp_preload` che [base.blade.php:19](resources/views/layouts/base.blade.php#L19) inietta prima dei CSS. **Pagine aggiornate:** - [homepage.blade.php](resources/views/homepage.blade.php) e [category.blade.php](resources/views/products/category.blade.php) — refactor dei blocchi `@php` esistenti al componente. Bonus: le larghezze hardcodate erano sbagliate (es. la categoria dichiarava `3840w` per la taglia L, che in realtà è 2160px — il browser avrebbe scelto il file sbagliato). - [products/detail.blade.php](resources/views/products/detail.blade.php) — preload di `product.img_2` (cover prodotto). - [portfolio/detail.blade.php](resources/views/portfolio/detail.blade.php), [news/detail.blade.php](resources/views/news/detail.blade.php), [press/detail.blade.php](resources/views/press/detail.blade.php) — preload della prima immagine della gallery, saltato quando la gallery è preceduta dal video (in quel caso l'immagine non è LCP). - [company/bespoke.blade.php](resources/views/company/bespoke.blade.php) — preload di `img_1`/`img_1_mobi` con media query, come la `` in pagina. - [designers/detail.blade.php](resources/views/designers/detail.blade.php) — preload di `img_profile`. **Coerenza col preload:** dove l'immagine LCP era ancora in lazy load l'ho resa eager con `fetchpriority=high` (news, press, bespoke, designer), altrimenti il preload sarebbe stato mezzo sprecato — la risorsa arriverebbe presto ma il render aspetterebbe comunque lazysizes. Ho anche corretto un bug preesistente in portfolio: `$attr` non veniva azzerato nel ramo `else`, quindi *tutte* le immagini della gallery ereditavano `fetchpriority=high`. **Verifica:** tutte le blade compilano (`view:cache`), e con curl ho confermato il tag corretto su categoria, portfolio, designer e prodotto; l'`imagesrcset` del preload coincide esattamente con il `srcset` dell'``, quindi il browser riusa la risorsa precaricata. Molte pagine locali hanno `src=""` perché lo storage non è sincronizzato col DB — succedeva già con `ResponsiveImage`, in produzione con i file presenti il tag esce. **Escluse volutamente:** pagine indice (news, press, realizzazioni, designers, cataloghi) e azienda/vetro/kaleido, dove l'LCP è il titolo testuale o un video, non un'immagine precaricabile.
